title: Practice 6: One direction, or round and about

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Мы ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., past pl.) туда.
exercises.why: **шли** — past tense (plural) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., past m. sg.) бы туда.
exercises.why: **шёл** — past tense (masculine) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: Ты куда ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., past m. sg.)?
